source.title: Pathfinder Society Intro: Year of Boundless Wonder

items.name: Drag
items.text: The enormous rat makes a jaws Strike against a Prone enemy. If it hits, in addition to dealing damage, the enormous rat Strides up to 10 feet, dragging the enemy along.

items.name: Filth Fever
items.text:
The Sickened and Unconscious conditions from filth fever don't improve on their own until the disease is cured.

Saving Throw DC 14 Fortitude save

---

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1d4 hours)

Stage 2 Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 Sickened 1 and Slowed 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 Unconscious (1 day)

Stage 5 dead

items.name: Gnaw Bones
items.text: A creature that's critically hit by an enormous rat must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save save or become Wounded 1 as the creature's bones or cartilage are crushed by the rat's jaws.
